title: Empirical analysis of context based content delivery for M-learning scenarios using ANFIS
reason: ANFIS model of content-format preference from questionnaire answers about context, device and preferences; evaluated by RMSE across membership functions. No LMS-recorded indicator, and no relation to learning success or a personality-related construct.

extraction.n_quote: The context relative information has been collected in real ... time where 700 engineering students participated.
extraction.notes: Only RMSE of ANFIS membership functions is reported; no learning outcome.
